g.text: Scripts speak verbs; a provider speaks its host
ops/*.sh — mr-upsert, watch, note, issue-upsert, milestone-sync, after-merge …
verbs: p_mr_get · p_run_jobs · p_job_log · p_note_post · p_issue_create · p_milestone_search …
gitlab: merge request · pipeline · job trace · issue link blocks
github: pull request (number) · workflow runs[] per commit · Actions log · no links → Blocked by #n in the managed region
gitea: pull request (index) · Actions run · issue dependencies · flagged experimental until a live run
Detected from the origin remote, or SILKOPS_PROVIDER. Same JSON keys everywhere, plus the host alias (number, run_id). A human merges on every host.
